coach.name: Leo
coach.title: Grandmaster coach
coach.tagline: Every strong player was once a beginner who kept going. Let's go.

habit.title: Red light
habit.question: What are they threatening?
habit.detail: Before you think about your move, look at theirs. What does their last move attack? Is anything of yours unprotected? Is a check or a mate coming?

habit.title: Yellow light
habit.question: Any checks, captures or attacks?
habit.detail: Now look for your chances: every check, every capture, every attack. Forcing moves first, because they leave your opponent the fewest choices.

habit.title: Green light
habit.question: Is my move safe?
habit.detail: Picked a move? Picture it on the board first. Can they take that piece? Does it leave something else unprotected? If it's safe, go.

skills.title: Good captures
skills.blurb: Pawn 1, knight and bishop 3, rook 5, queen 9. Know when a capture wins.

skills.title: Their threats
skills.blurb: Every move they make wants something. Find out what.
skills.prompt: Their last move attacks something of yours. Tap what's in danger.

skills.title: Safe moves
skills.blurb: Before you let go of a piece, check that they can't win it.

skills.title: Free pieces
skills.blurb: Spot the piece nobody is guarding, and take it.
skills.prompt: Something of theirs isn't protected, or is worth more than the piece you can take it with. Win it.

skills.title: Mate in one
skills.blurb: Find the one move that ends the game.

skills.title: Back-rank mate
skills.blurb: A king stuck behind its own pawns can't escape a rook or queen.
skills.prompt: Their king is stuck on the back row. Finish it.

skills.title: Mate in two
skills.blurb: A forcing move, their only reply, then checkmate.

skills.title: Opening rules
skills.blurb: Take the center, bring out your pieces, castle. That's the recipe.
skills.prompt: Which move follows the opening rules?

skills.title: Forks
skills.blurb: One piece attacks two. They can only save one.

skills.title: Pins
skills.blurb: Freeze a piece in front of a bigger one.

skills.title: Skewers
skills.blurb: Attack the big piece and win the one behind it.

skills.title: Discovered attacks
skills.blurb: Move one piece and uncover an attack from another.

skills.title: Queen checkmate
skills.blurb: King and queen against a lone king. Box it in, then finish.
skills.prompt: Checkmate with your queen in {limit} moves or fewer. Watch out for stalemate!

skills.title: Ladder mate
skills.blurb: Two rooks walk the king to the edge, one step at a time.
skills.prompt: Checkmate with your two rooks in {limit} moves or fewer.

skills.title: Rook checkmate
skills.blurb: King and rook working as a team.
skills.prompt: Checkmate with king and rook in {limit} moves or fewer.

greeting: Good to see you. Let's find some patterns.
Welcome back. A few minutes a day is how strong players are made.
Ready when you are. I picked something good for today.
Hello again! You remember more than you think. Let's prove it.
Every game you play shows me what to teach you next.
Small steps, every day. That's the whole secret.
correct: Now you're thinking like a master.
correctAfterHint: There it is. Hints are how we learn.
Got it. Next time you'll see it sooner.
Yes! Asking for help is a strength.
wrong: Not that one. What else is there?
Almost. Check every check, capture and attack.
Not this time. Take a breath and look again.
tilt: That was a tough one. Let's warm back up with something lighter.
Even grandmasters miss these. Here's an easier one to get the rhythm back.
No stress. A quick win, then we'll go again.
sessionDone: That's a session. Your future self says thanks.
Nicely done. These patterns are sinking in.
Session complete. Go play a game and use what you learned.
Done for today. I'll have fresh ones for you tomorrow.
lessonDone: Lesson done. Now let's make it stick with a few puzzles.
You've got the idea. Practice makes it automatic.
That's the lesson. Ready to try it yourself?
restDay: Your streak is safe. Everyone needs a rest day.
Welcome back! I used a rest day to keep your streak going.
promotion: Promoted! The board looks different from up here.
